semantic_summary: UK PRTR 2024 CSV and PRTR guidance expose facility releases with measured/calculated/estimated method codes; method and threshold semantics must be preserved.

Environment Agency Pollution Inventory contains annual mass releases from regulated industrial sites and is a strong facility-emissions candidate surface, but permit-wide scope still needs parcel geometry.
EPR Industrial Sites March 2026 is a strong permit/facility binding candidate but not an emissions measurement by itself.
NAEI point-source data has known locations and grid references; some values may be reported, estimated or modelled, so method labelling is mandatory.
NAEI 1x1km gridded data cannot be converted to cadastral parcel measurements; attached point-source files may be assessed separately.
Incinerator annual monitoring packages remain high-value report-level measurement candidates pending row extraction, units and facility geometry.
No direct PRTR CSV row was available through the current client after the download/cache failure, so no facility value was invented or promoted.
